source='''def transform(grid):
    # Solid color-2 lines divide the grid into panels. Mark a panel when it
    # contains exactly two cells that differ from its dominant background.
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    colors = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0 + 1, r1) for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
            row.append(1 if sum(v != background for v in cells) == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

def transform(grid):
    # Solid color-2 lines divide the grid into panels. Mark a panel when it
    # contains exactly two cells that differ from its dominant background.
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    colors = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0 + 1, r1) for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
            row.append(1 if sum(v != background for v in cells) == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
